items.html: And this is what is said in Idra Rabba, page 128: "And from this skull a dew drips upon that which is outside it," as it is written, "For my head is filled with dew..." And it is Zeir Anpin, which clothes Arich Anpin. Thus it is found that at times, in one aspect, the hairs are greater and superior to the whitenesses; and in another aspect, it is the reverse.
